title: Technical Architect  _ Product & Client Solutions
description:
Technical Architect Product & Client Solutions 
 Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced Fractional Technical / Solution Architect to provide senior technical leadership across multiple software product development and client implementation projects.
The role will be responsible for reviewing system architecture and technical designs, establishing development and maintenance standards, reviewing critical code and technical implementations, guiding developers in troubleshooting and complex technical issues, and ensuring that products are developed using scalable, secure and maintainable architectures.
The role will work across varied client requirements and should therefore have broad experience across software architecture, APIs, authentication/SSO, security, integrations, cloud, databases, DevOps and product engineering.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Architecture & Technical Design 
 Review business requirements and translate them into appropriate technical architectures. Review and approve application, database, API and integration architecture. Evaluate technology choices and recommend appropriate solutions. Review scalability, performance, security and maintainability of proposed designs. Guide decisions such as monolith vs. microservices, technology selection and integration architecture. Prepare/review architecture diagrams and technical design documents. 2. Product Development 
 Provide technical direction for development of SaaS/web-based products. Guide developers from architecture and design through development, deployment and maintenance. Establish reusable architecture and technical components wherever appropriate. Ensure products are designed for scalability, security and maintainability. 3. Code & Development Review 
 Review critical source code and pull requests. Establish coding standards and code-review practices. Identify architectural issues, technical debt, security vulnerabilities and performance concerns. Review database structures, APIs and critical business logic. Guide refactoring and improvement of existing applications. 4. Security & Identity 
Strong understanding of:
 SSO OAuth 2.0 OpenID Connect SAML JWT RBAC MFA concepts Encryption at rest and in transit Secure API design Secrets and key management OWASP and secure coding practices Audit logging and access control 5. API & Integration Architecture 
 Design and review REST APIs and third-party integrations. Review API authentication, authorization, versioning and error handling. Guide ERP, payment, external application and data integrations. Review integration reliability, retry mechanisms and data synchronization. 6. Cloud & DevOps 
 Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP. Understanding of Docker/containerisation and CI/CD. Review deployment architecture and environment strategy. Establish development, testing, UAT and production deployment practices. Guide application monitoring, logging, alerting and rollback procedures. 7. Troubleshooting & Technical Support 
 Guide developers in resolving complex application, database, API and deployment issues. Perform root-cause analysis of production issues. Assist with performance, scalability and reliability problems. Establish systematic troubleshooting and incident-management practices. 8. Engineering Process & Governance 
Establish and monitor processes covering:
Requirement Technical Design Architecture Review Development Code Review QA UAT Deployment Monitoring Maintenance
 Define technical documentation standards. Define Git and branching practices. Establish code-review and release-management processes. Establish standards for development and maintenance. Conduct periodic technical health reviews of applications. 9. Team Mentoring 
 Mentor developers and technical leads. Guide developers in architecture and technology decisions. Improve engineering practices and technical capability of the team. Act as the senior technical escalation point for the development team. Required Experience 
 1015+ years of software engineering experience. 5+ years in Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Principal Engineer, Engineering Lead or equivalent senior technical roles. Proven experience in end-to-end product development. Experience architecting and reviewing multiple software applications/products. Experience reviewing code written by other developers. Experience leading or mentoring software development teams. Experience working with multiple technologies and client requirements. Experience in production systems and troubleshooting. Experience with SaaS/product development is highly desirable. Technical Skills 
 Strong architectural understanding of: Backend technologies such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js or equivalent React/Angular/Vue or equivalent frontend technologies PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server REST APIs and integrations OAuth/OIDC/SAML/JWT RBAC and application security Encryption and secure data handling AWS/Azure/GCP Docker and CI/CD Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket Application monitoring and logging Database and application performance Distributed/integration systems The candidate need not be an expert programmer in every technology listed, but should have sufficient hands-on experience and architectural understanding to review implementations and guide development teams. Preferred Background 
 Experience in any of the following environments would be advantageous: Product engineering companies SaaS companies Software consulting/implementation companies ERP/integration projects Enterprise application development Data/analytics platforms AI-enabled applications Multi-tenant SaaS products Key Characteristics 
The ideal candidate should be:
 Technically strong and hands-on enough to understand implementation issues. Architecture-oriented rather than technology-specific. Comfortable reviewing and challenging technical decisions. Strong in security and integration architecture. Experienced in production troubleshooting. Able to work with multiple development teams and projects. Practical and cost-conscious in technology decisions. Good at mentoring developers. Comfortable working on a part-time/fractional basis. Engagement 
 Part-time / Fractional engagement 
 Expected involvement: on need basis, with flexibility to increase involvement during major architecture, production or client implementation requirements. The role will function as the senior technical authority across multiple products and client projects , while day-to-day development will continue to be handled by the internal development team. title: AI Solution Architect(Looking For Immediate Joiners Only)
description:
Design and lead production-ready AI/GenAI solutions using Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI Agents, and tool calling. Define AI boundaries, evaluation, guardrails, human review, and release processes. Own the end-to-end Azure application architecture, from design through production. Design scalable application architecture using DDD, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, Azure SQL, Service Bus, and CI/CD. Lead legacy modernization, architecture decisions, code/design reviews, and technical teams. Create C4 diagrams and ADRs and communicate architecture, costs, and risks to technical and business stakeholders. 
 Required Skills: Has 12+ years of software engineering experience and 5+ years as an Architect. Has shipped GenAI/LLM applications to production, specifically RAG or tool-calling agents, structured outputs, and prompt/model versioning. Has real experience with AI evaluation and guardrails in productionnot just GenAI development. Can make sound decisions on where AI should and should not be used, with real project examples. Has owned production architecture using Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, domain boundaries, and Anti-Corruption Layers. Is still hands-on/coding with Azure + .NET or Node.js, including Azure SQL, Service Bus, hosting, CI/CD, and IaC. 
 Additional Experience Desired: Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture and tenant isolation. Experience with legacy modernization, including Strangler Fig, feature flags, and parity validation. Experience with Azure AI Document Intelligence and document generation/rendering. Exposure to .NET and Node.js, with Python for AI services. Experience with third-party integrations such as e-signature, payments, messaging, and data feeds. Knowledge of OpenID Connect/SAML, Web Components, and design-token systems. Experience with AI cost optimization, including token usage and cost per tenant. Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure AI Engineer certification.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:

 Location: Remote Role Summary We are looking for a Senior AI Solution Architect / Agentic Workflow Lead with 6+ years of experience in designing and delivering production-grade GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions. This is a design and technical leadership role requiring strong architecture, hands-on delivery, engineering guidance, and technical design ownership. Strong production experience with RAG embeddings, chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citations and long-document retrieval. Strong experience with Agentic/Stateful workflows. Hands-on experience with LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Temporal, Azure Durable Functions, or equivalent. Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows and approval/escalation mechanisms. Strong knowledge of structured LLM outputs, JSON/schema validation, retries and fallback mechanisms. Experience designing APIs, data models, workflow states and backend-ready architecture. Experience with LLMOps, tracing and evaluation, preferably Langfuse. Strong Azure AI experience, especially: Azure OpenAI Azure AI Search Azure AI Foundry Azure Functions / Container Apps Knowledge of Prompt Injection, LLM Security and safe tool execution. Strong technical leadership and experience guiding engineering teams. Good to Have MCP A2A Fine-tuning Model Distillation Multi-Agent Architecture Enterprise SaaS experience Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end GenAI and Agentic AI architecture. Lead RAG and AI workflow design for production systems. Define deterministic vs. AI-driven workflow components. Create technical designs, API contracts, schemas and implementation plans. Guide and review AI/backend engineers. Establish AI evaluation, tracing and regression-testing practices. Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, reliable and cost-effective.
